## Activity

Central Eye Clinic completed its planned imaging activity during February 2025. A total of 174 captures were recorded for the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Overall activity was maintained in line with the scheduled service arrangements, with no other operational issues noted in the available report.

## Image quality

Of the 174 captures, 4 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.3. The result should continue to be monitored through routine review of capture practice and image quality feedback. The available information does not identify any further quality concerns for the reporting period.

## Grading

A total of 51 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 3. These figures provide the main activity and turnaround measures for February 2025. Continued review of referable findings and grading timeliness will support oversight of the service and help identify any emerging operational issues.
